title: Train softmax regression on four blobs
summary: Train multinomial logistic regression with gradient descent to reach a held-out accuracy and log loss target on four Gaussian blobs.

mutants.grad_missing_onehot: Uses the probabilities as the error and forgets to subtract the one-hot targets.
mutants.no_bias_update: Never updates the biases, so each class keeps the same base score.
mutants.no_standardize: Trains on the raw features without the mean and std scaling, so 500 steps are not enough.
mutants.no_max_shift: Calls np.exp on the raw scores, so far points overflow and give NaN.
mutants.softmax_wrong_axis: Normalizes the exponentials over the batch axis 0 and not over the classes.
mutants.standardizes_in_place: Scales X in place with -= and /=, so the caller's array changes.
